name: creator
description: Create portal: a de-privileged app frame that mints a dDRM asset on PQ custody. Drives encrypt-provider (seal_inline_threshold), publish-provider (prepare_publish), wallet (sign), and chain-provider (broadcast) through host-mediated capabilities. Swaps the Lit CEK system for the dKMS threshold escrow (cenc:elastos-pq-hybrid-threshold-v0); holds no keys, no chain RPC, no wallet.
author: elastos
